contract: Compare the named hydrogen-suppressed Hall-Kier graph descriptors Kappa1,Kappa2,Kappa3 and Hall-Kier alpha. A differing index must differ by more than1e-10. Separately obtain the fraction of carbon atoms that are sp3;it is not a geometric shape observable.
question: Report Kappa triples in source order,the two Hall-Kier alphas,and the names Kappa1/Kappa2/Kappa3 that distinguish the graphs. Decide whether equal sp3-carbon fractions rule out a branching difference.
scope: Fixed-graph descriptor resolution only,not measured conformations,stability or an injective graph fingerprint.
